title: Bellum Civile
description: Bellum Civile with its Coop compat module (coop-compat/BellumCivileCoopCompat) in Coop: every part of the module finds what it patches in this Bellum, a civil war is ended by the server and the players see it end, and a peace a player's realm proposes gets past Bellum's guard on the server.
